final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT t.observstation, o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step4 AS (SELECT s.weathprofile, AVG(s.avg_bandwidth) AS avg_bandwidth, AVG(s.record_count) AS avg_count, AVG(1.0 * s.record_count / step2.total_count) AS avg_share FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.total_count IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.weathprofile) SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth), AVG(avg_count), AVG(avg_share) FROM step4
